objective: Package 26.6a: a family picked from a table's meta-features against always-XGBoost, always-random-forest and the most frequent winner, by normalised regret on held-out problem kinds.
rule: A measurement on verified invented problems of DCLab's engine kinds: how close a family picked from meta-features comes to the best family of each problem's own screen, judged on problem kinds the meta-model never saw. It says nothing yet about real tables, nor that any pick beats a tuned search.
